title: Sugar Butter Pro-Shot!  So happy the Waitress film is finally here… k...
transcript: So I finally got to see The Waitress pro-shot which we have been waiting for for almost 2 years now and it's finally here… kind of? It premiered at Tribeca Film Festival for 3 nights and it also streamed live in Times Square for free and that's how I got to see it I have to say I think this may be one of the best if not the best recorded Broadway shows that they've done so far like I honestly think this should be the new gold standard of pro shots I often find with pro shots they never know how to get the balance of like up close and personal so that you can see the expressions on the actor's faces and also the wide shots so you can actually see the full stage and the full tableau like you would if you were in a theater and I find that a lot of the pro-shots will typically over focus on the closer shots and I'm always just begging them to like zoom out I wanna see the full picture and I felt like that was what this Waitress pro-shot did really really well was they used a lot of wide and mid shots that really gave you a full sense of what was going on on the stage and then zoomed in when necessary and when the emotion demanded it It's also like the Avengers of waitress cast because they assembled people from all throughout their Broadway run to come back to film this pro shot so they have some original Broadway cast members like Drew Gehling and Chris Fitzgerald and then they have other cast members that joined later on in the run including of course Sara Bareilles who is playing Jenna in the pro-shot and she is So! Good! Sara Bareilles is just a gift to musical theater and I am so glad that she is now in her musical theater phase because I love Waitress I love the music in Waitress I love her performance in Waitress I loved her in Into the Woods and it was just announced that she's writing a new musical which I also cannot wait for A lot of people were asking me in my comments of my last TikTok when they can see this and unfortunately the answer is we don't know It's premiering at Tribeca and then hopefully a streaming platform will be able to pick it up so that we can all watch it from the comfort of our own homes and as many times as we want because I cannot wait to rewatch this thing but for now I'm just really glad that this even exists at all and for those who were not able to see it in New York I promise you it will be worth the wait so let's see what happens
